question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical experimental Claw package artifact once the preceding lifecycle stack is ready for mainline review?
rationale: This is a new user-facing package-format and export-default contract, not a narrow repair; the protected maintainer label and unresolved stacked base require explicit owner sponsorship before a merge decision.

options.title: Sponsor the single-format contract
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format after the lifecycle stack lands or is restacked onto main and exact-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

options.title: Retain JSON as canonical
options.body: Keep JSON export as the experimental package artifact and decline the new Markdown-frontmatter authoring contract for now.

options.title: Narrow the direction
options.body: Request a smaller proposal that proves the authoring format without changing the canonical export artifact.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the single-format contract
recommendation.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical export format after the lifecycle stack lands or is restacked onto main and exact-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active manifest-format slice and prior stacked implementation history, making them the best available routing contact for the technical contract.
